hook_text: Heatwave, thunderstorm, misty morning: one week that changed everything.
clip_script: Mbombela, Mpumalanga. Monday: a heatwave. Water bottles, hats, mangoes in the shade, netball moved to the morning. Wednesday: a thunderstorm. A flooded bridge, a power cut, rain for the crops but hail on the fruit. Friday: thick mist, cars crawling with lights on. Weather changes what we wear, eat and do, how we travel and work. And when it gets extreme, listen to warnings, stay indoors, and never cross floodwater.
visual_style: Whiteboard calendar with Monday sun, Wednesday storm cloud, Friday mist, and little scenes of people changing what they do.
mood: Lively and practical, like a week-in-the-life story.
pacing: Day by day, ending with clear safety tips.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make a chart of how the weather changes your own week.
